title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jd:
About the Company ClosedML is a remote-first artificial intelligence company building advanced machine learning solutions for enterprise clients. Focused on deploying practical, production-grade AI systems, ClosedML works closely with customers to embed intelligent automation into their core workflows, combining deep technical expertise with a strong emphasis on measurable business outcomes.
About the Role ClosedML is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer with around 4 years of experience to join our fully remote team. In this role, you will work directly with clients to understand their operational challenges, then design, build, and deploy customised machine learning solutions that integrate seamlessly into their existing systems. You will serve as a technical bridge between ClosedML's core product and each client's unique environment, balancing rapid development with close customer collaboration.
Key Responsibilities Engage directly with client stakeholders remotely to gather requirements and identify opportunities for AI-driven solutions. Design, build, and deploy custom integrations and machine learning workflows tailored to client needs. Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions based on real-time client feedback. Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for deployed systems. Collaborate with internal engineering and research teams to relay client insights and inform the product roadmap. Maintain clear documentation and communication throughout each deployment.
Requirements Approximately 4 years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or a similar client-facing technical role. Strong programming skills, with proficiency in Python and experience working with machine learning frameworks. Experience deploying and supporting production software or ML systems in client environments. Excellent problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. Strong communication skills, with the ability to build trust with clients remotely. Self-motivated and comfortable working independently within a distributed team.
Benefits Salary of 60,000 to 80,000 GBP, dependent on experience. Fully remote working with flexible hours. Home office setup allowance. Generous paid time off. Health and wellness benefits. Opportunities for professional development and career growth. A collaborative, mission-driven team culture focused on delivering impactful AI solutions.
